ED_Title: Election of non-permanent members of the Security Council
ED_DecisionText:
At its 86th plenary meeting, on 3 June 2026, the General Assembly, in accordance with Article 23 of the Charter of the United Nations, rule 142 of the rules of procedure of the Assembly and paragraph 17 of Assembly resolution 68/307 of 10 September 2014, elected Austria, Kyrgyzstan, Portugal, Trinidad and Tobago and Zimbabwe as non-permanent members of the Security Council for a two-year term of office beginning on 1 January 2027 to fill the vacancies occurring on the expiration of the terms of office of Denmark, Greece, Pakistan, Panama and Somalia.

As a result, as of 1 January 2027, the Security Council is composed of the following 15 Member States: Austria,** Bahrain,* China, Colombia,* Democratic Republic of the Congo,* France, Kyrgyzstan,** Latvia,* Liberia,* Portugal,** Russian Federation, Trinidad and Tobago,** United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, United States of America and Zimbabwe.**

__________________
* Term of office expires on 31 December 2027.
** Term of office expires on 31 December 2028.
